تنتقلون (form VIII)
# تَنْتَقِلُونَ (tantaqilūna) /tan.ta.qi.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَقَلَ (intaqala)
# تُنْتَقَلُونَ (tuntaqalūna) /tun.ta.qa.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَقَلَ (intaqala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
